Cowabunga dude! Where did you come from?
Were you expecting maybe the Addams Family?
My favourite pizza flavors are marshmallow anchovy, or chocolate fudge garlic!

properties.name: Dialogue
properties.value: This is my new mutagen phase-disruptor. It aligns our cells to fix any cross-over phase issues when travelling to Dimension-X. It still has a few kinks, but it's looking promising.

properties.name: Text
properties.value: Damn! I can't get passed this level in Double Dragon!

properties.name: Dialogue
properties.value:
Ribbit, ribbit...hello young traveller, I can give you some tips if you need some.
You can light up torches by walking up to them and pressing the Action button.
You can run by holding the Action button while moving.
Lighting certain torches may help you progress.
Some walls are not what they seem.
What, you want more? The game comes with a manual with more help.

properties.name: Dialogue
properties.value: Hey there! Want a new look? I can only fit you with the ones you've earned.
